question_full: During INC-2000 on checkout-prod-01, why did checkout writes appear to hang while reads continued? Determine whether CHG-1000 or CHG-1001 caused the incident, identify the customer impact visible to the current principal, explain what evidence rules out the alternative change, and cite the lock evidence and approved runbook supporting both immediate recovery and the preventive follow-up.
question_compact: Why did writes hang during INC-2000, which change caused it, who was affected, and what was the safe recovery?

typo_probe.note: Letter transposition. Chosen because it clears the threshold against exactly one row. The former CHG-0100 tied at 0.5000 with CHG-1100.

evidence.title: Ordinary CREATE INDEX on orders(customer_id)
evidence.quote: CREATE INDEX idx_orders_customer_id ON orders (customer_id); executed against checkout-prod-01 at 09:17 UTC without the CONCURRENTLY option.

evidence.title: Checkout worker pool resize
evidence.quote: Checkout worker pool resized from 24 to 32 workers at 09:05 UTC. Change is application-tier only and acquires no database locks.

evidence.title: Rebuild index with CREATE INDEX CONCURRENTLY
evidence.quote: Rebuild scheduled using CREATE INDEX CONCURRENTLY outside a transaction block, with progress monitoring and INVALID index cleanup on failure.

evidence.title: Checkout read-replica endpoint rotation
evidence.quote: Read-replica endpoint rotated to the new reader endpoint. No writer-side effect.

evidence.title: Checkout writes blocked while reads continued
evidence.quote: Sev-2 declared 09:24 UTC. Checkout write transactions queued on checkout-prod-01 while read traffic served normally. Approximately 34 minutes of blocked writes.

evidence.title: Older checkout deploy incident
evidence.quote: Checkout latency incident traced to a bad application deploy. Writes and reads both degraded. No database lock involvement.

evidence.title: Writer 4182 blocked by index backend 3944
evidence.quote: pid 4182 waiting on Lock:relation, blocked by pid 3944 holding ShareLock on orders. wait_event_type=Lock, wait_event=relation.

evidence.title: Writer 4210 blocked by index backend 3944
evidence.quote: pid 4210 waiting on Lock:relation, blocked by the same pid 3944. Confirms a single blocker rather than lock contention among writers.

evidence.title: Acme Retail checkout failures
evidence.quote: Acme Retail reported checkout submission failures beginning 09:38 UTC. Confirmed affected; browse and search unaffected.

evidence.title: Regulated account write errors
evidence.quote: Regulated account reported write errors during the same window. Record is restricted to the support-lead principal.

evidence.title: Zenith Corp impact inquiry
evidence.quote: Zenith Corp asked whether they were affected. Their traffic is served by a separate cluster; no impact recorded during the window.

evidence.title: Concurrent index builds on production writers
evidence.quote: Cancel the blocking build, then rebuild with CREATE INDEX CONCURRENTLY outside a transaction block. Monitor pg_stat_progress_create_index and drop any INVALID index before retrying.

evidence.title: Generic write-latency triage
evidence.quote: General write-latency triage: check connection saturation, checkpoint tuning, and autovacuum backlog.

evidence.title: RCA and safe-fix plan for Acme Retail
evidence.quote: Committed to Acme Retail: written RCA and a preventive safe-fix plan by 2026-05-26.

timeline.event: Checkout worker pool resized (no locks taken)
CREATE INDEX starts on orders, no CONCURRENTLY
Writer 4210 blocked by the same backend
Sev-2 declared: writes hang, reads normal
Blocking build cancelled (~34 min of blocked writes)
Rebuild scheduled with CREATE INDEX CONCURRENTLY
RCA and safe-fix plan committed to Acme Retail
